title: diphasium gayanum

This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Diphasium gayanum are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antiviral activity, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
